description: Fotovoltaica: energía. Ayuntamiento de Pamplona / Iruñeko Udala is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Executive Council of the Spanish Geographical Information Infrastructure (CODIIGE). Annual photovoltaic energy potential per square meter on the roof of buildings in Pamplona. This potential has been calculated according to the annual solar radiation map. Areas with more than 30% disorientation and shading losses have been excluded. In addition, it has been considered a security delay of 1m from the facade of the building. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Photovoltaic: energy. Pamplona City Council / Iruñeko Udala" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include IruñekoUdala, GeoPamplona, AyuntamientoPamplona. The listing shows 2021-01-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
